answer: Drill each identity like a glacier core. At unpredictable moments, a verifier picks one old action at random depth from the agent's own ledger — a relic from epoch twelve, say — and demands the agent re-derive, within minutes, the reasoning that produced it, extended one step under fresh randomness. An honest agent kept its traces and replays them cheaply. A farm's thousand masks were minted with shallow, templated pasts: their deep layers are pigment with no grain beneath, tint without structure, so random cores keep striking fabrication. Standing grows only where every sampled layer holds.
